name: zn15_45_dezone_across_city_edge
description: ZG21 (zones §5.1, “A rectangle that crosses the city edge”): the dezone under a new network clips its bounding rectangle to the city (the outside cells are clear bits) and dezones the inside cells, as the original does for every defined cell. A 16 x 16 city zoned 1 along row z = 5 and column x = 15. A network occupant whose bounding cells are {-2, 5, 1, 5} dezones (0, 5) and (1, 5) and leaves (2, 5) zoned; one at {14, 3, 17, 3} crossing the high x edge dezones (14, 3) and (15, 3); one at {15, 14, 15, 18} crossing the high z edge dezones (15, 14) and (15, 15). One entirely outside ({20, 20, 22, 20}) changes nothing. Before ZG21 the whole call was refused (ZG2) and the inside cells stayed zoned.
